{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}')

# Verify status values
print(f'Status values: {df["status"].unique()}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
customer_age_neg1 = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of customer_age = -1: {len(customer_age_neg1)}')"}
